tools.name: get_networks
tools.description: The EVM networks where Soheil Router is live: chain id, name, our contract, its fee and fee wallet, and the contracts a trade may call. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_api_info
tools.description: What the Soheil Router API is: version, router fee, the most an integrator may add, how keys are given, and where the docs and OpenAPI spec are. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The best price for a token swap on one network and the transaction that makes it, through our contract. Returns toAmount, toAmountMin (enforced on-chain), the fees, approvalAddress (approve it for exactly fromAmount first unless fromToken is the coin) and transactionRequest for the user to sign. Nee

tools.name: get_trade_status
tools.description: Where a sent trade stands, from its transaction on chain: PENDING, DONE (with what was paid and received), FAILED, NOT_FOUND or NOT_OURS. Needs an API key.
